daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you permission to be a little selfish today. Your scales are tilting toward self-care, and honestly? That's the move. Channel this reflective energy into doing something that feels like a hug from the universe.
daily.love: Whether you're coupled up or solo, there's a vibe shift happening around your heart space. If you're with someone, a real conversation could hit different today. If you're flying solo, self-love energy is literally glowing rn.
daily.career: Your creative wavelength is strong today—trust those random ideas that pop up. This is prime time to pitch something you've been sitting on or approach a project from a totally new angle. Your intuition knows what's up.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement that actually feels good, not punishment. A walk, stretching, dancing in your room—whatever brings you joy. Also, hydration check: you're probably not drinking enough water, bestie.

weekly.overview: This week's energy feels like finding the perfect playlist after scrolling forever. Venus is blessing your vibe with clarity, so trust those gut feelings that have been whispering lately. Things are shifting in your favor if you lean into authenticity.
weekly.love: Someone's paying attention to the real you this week, not just the polished version. If you're coupled up, vulnerable convos hit different rn—lean into them. Single? That connection you've been manifesting is closer than you think.
weekly.career: Your ideas are actually genius this week, even if imposter syndrome tries to convince you otherwise. This is the energy to pitch, propose, or pivot. Trust your instincts about what needs to change and move accordingly.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Rest isn't laziness—it's strategic. Whether that's a meditation sesh, actual sleep, or just doing less, your nervous system will thank you for listening to what it needs.
